title: Laptop connected to Wi-Fi but no internet access
content:
Problem: Laptop connected to Wi-Fi but no internet access on macOS. It happens on my work laptop.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Restarted the network adapter and flushed the DNS cache.

title: Renew Windows IP Address - Guide 3
content: For Wi-Fi connected with no internet, run ipconfig /release followed by ipconfig /renew, then reconnect to the wireless network.

title: DNS Cache Recovery - Guide 1
content: If Wi-Fi is connected but internet access is unavailable, open Command Prompt and run ipconfig /flushdns. Reconnect to Wi-Fi and test again.
